label: Спросить
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for спросить (to ask).

missions.phrase: Я спрошу учителя об этом завтра.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person. Спросить is perfective, so 'спрошу' is its simple future and needs no auxiliary. Note the 1sg mutation с → ш in спрошу, against спросишь elsewhere.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person. 'Спросишь' shows the -ишь ending with the unmutated стем спрос-. As a perfective, it points to a single completed act, not a habit.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person singular. 'Спросит' carries the -ит ending and means a one-time future asking. The pair partner is imperfective спрашивать for repeated action.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Спросим' uses the -им ending; the perfective frames a single intended question about timing.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person plural. 'Спросят' closes the person set with the -ят ending. Perfective спросить contrasts with iterative спрашивать.

missions.phrase: Вчера он спросил меня о работе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective past, masculine. 'Спросил' is the completed -л past of спросить. 'Вчера' anchors the single finished act of asking.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, feminine. 'Спросила' adds the feminine -ла ending. The completed question is reported with an embedded clause about location.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, plural. 'Спросили' is the plural -ли past, shared by all genders. 'О новой игре' shows the о + prepositional topic of the question.
Strategic focus: Perfective imperative, singular. 'Спроси' is the informal command of спросить. 'У него' marks the person you ask; the perfective fits a single request.
Strategic focus: Infinitive use. 'Спросить' stays in the dictionary form after the evaluative 'лучше'. This bare infinitive gives general, timeless advice.
